name: Faye
source:
A patient of the clinic. A Siamese cat.
Her condition causes emotional instability, her moods going up and down quickly, like she has two different personalities?
Though she's usually a confident (if manic) type of person, she can quickly become paranoid and depressed, refusing to interact with anyone.
Self-conscious about going into heat. Will refuse treatment until she's almost driven mad by her condition.

[description from Getchu]
